scope: Category A Fresh Food & Kitchen Tabletop; Franka DROID single arm, catalog A1-A5 plus generated fruit siblings. Filesystem evidence only; no new simulation, no database access or mutation.

precedence: eval_telemetry.ttl aggregate metrics and graph/policy labels
index.html rendered duplicate of episode records, not independent trials
lineage.json / lineage.ttl exact eval-dir version links
current generated specs/configs and reference documents, not proof of execution
methodology.episode_key: run directory + rank file + seed + env_id + episode_in_env; exact-row duplicate scan also uses full record including timestamp
methodology.seed_warning: All recovered A1 episodes use simulation seed 42; vector environment IDs are not independent seeds. Remote policy diffusion seeding is not demonstrated.
methodology.dedup_warning: Do not sum HTML, TTL, lineage and JSONL representations as separate episodes. Do not drop low-progress success flags; preserve contradictions. Empty files are attempts, not zero-success trials with a positive denominator.
methodology.historical_source_hash_warning: Current spec/config/source digests are audit fingerprints, not historical runtime provenance. No historical run manifests or frozen server checkpoint identities were found.
methodology.videos: No video files in the recovered A1 run directories; no physical retained grasp or correct inside-bowl release certification is made. HDF5 files were statted only, never opened.
methodology.absence_scope: No execution found means within listed searched roots and evidence files, not a claim that no run ever happened anywhere. Anonymous empty outputs are retained as unattributed.

lineage_record.prompt: Create an environment for a Franka DROID robot on a maple table where the task is to pick up the red apple from the front right of the table and place it into the wooden bowl on the front left. Position the maple_table background at initial_pose position_xyz: [-0.25, 0.0, 0.0], use embodiment droid_abs_joint_pos at [-0.55, 0.0, 0.0], place apple_01_objaverse_robolab in front_right sector, and place wooden_bowl_hot3d_robolab in front_left sector.

versions.provenance_caveat: Digests are of files present during this audit, not historical runtime manifests. Version linkage is ledger evidence; no source/checkpoint digests were recorded in historical run folders.

diagnostics: camera_occlusion: Robot failed to contact or move target object (object_moved_rate=0.00). For VLA policies (e.g. GR00T-DROID, OpenVLA), objects placed without strict near-field constraints (d in [0.25m, 0.45m], X in [-0.30m, -0.10m]) fall outside the downward camera crop and teleoperation training distribution. The table must be shifted closer to the robot base.
horizon_truncation: Rollout was limited to 500 steps (10.0s), terminating before multi-stage pick-and-place completed.

versions.provenance_caveat: Digests are of files present during this audit, not historical runtime manifests. Version linkage is ledger evidence; no source/checkpoint digests were recorded in historical run folders.

diagnostics: in_flight_slip_inertia: Statistical Funnel Bottleneck (N=65): Robot achieved initial reach and lift in 86.2% of episodes, but conversion to successful placement was only 14.3%. High-lift with low-placement indicates in-flight rotational slippage, open-loop drift, or acceleration jerk during transport. Compress execution chunk to enable high-frequency receding horizon feedback.

metric_semantics.lift_current: object_lifted_above_resting_min(...distance=0.05,min_airborne_steps=1); a one-step height predicate, not sustained grasp proof.
metric_semantics.moved: TTL aggregate; current ObjectMovedRateMetric computes any per-step object linear speed norm > 0.5 m/s per recorded episode, then averages. This is neither displacement>3cm nor grasp/lift. Historical velocity payload absent; numerator reconstructed from TTL rate and n.
metric_semantics.conversion: Legacy count(success)/count(lift_event) is not conditional success|lift unless all successes are lifted. v2 violates that requirement; actual intersection is 4/56.
metric_semantics.duration: episode_length counts steps; report all-episode, raw-success-only, failure-only and all_complete-only distributions separately. Historical runtime step_dt not pinned; do not repeat deck seconds conversions as measured facts.
metric_semantics.progress_score: Unweighted mean of raw per-episode overall_score. Historical weights yield thirds; current run yields quarters (0.5 after settle and lift). Lineage progress_score=0.0 is not an observed raw progress mean.
